title: Battle HUD Overview
description: The match display shows each player’s health, Drive Gauge, Super Art gauge, timer and round indicators. Use the diagram to identify the main interface areas.

title: Health Bars & SA3 Scaling
description: Health bars show remaining vitality. This diagram illustrates health-bar presentation and Super Art Level 3 / Critical Art-related scaling; exact values depend on game rules and circumstances.

title: Combo Counter
description: Indicates consecutive hits in a combo.

title: Armor Break
description: Indicates an attack or interaction that breaks armor.

title: Counter Hit
description: Appears when an attack connects while the opponent is attempting an action.

title: Cross-Up
description: Indicates a hit that crosses the opponent’s guard direction.

title: Hard Knockdown
description: Indicates a hard knockdown situation, which changes the defender’s recovery options.

title: Lock
description: Indicates a lock-related combat state or effect.

title: Punish Counter
description: Indicates a hit on an opponent during the recovery of a move, with additional punish-counter effects.

title: Reversal
description: Indicates an action performed at the earliest available opportunity after a recovery or wake-up window.

title: Stun
description: Indicates the opponent has entered a stunned state.
